inputs.title: How a tap-to-pay payment goes through
inputs.caption_1: Your phone sends a one-time token, never the card number
inputs.caption_2: The checkout asks its payment processor to charge the token
inputs.caption_3: The network routes the request to the bank that issued the card
inputs.caption_4: Your bank checks the account and sends back approve or decline
inputs.takeaway: Four hops, and the shop never sees your card number
